programs.title: Justice, USA
programs.desc: The filmmakers talk about the criminal justice system in the United States using the example of Nashville, Tennessee.Both decision-makers, legal advisors and administrators of prisons, as well as the inmates themselves, have the opportunity to comment on this issue.Additionally, the production shows recordings from various types of prisons that supervise convicted men, women and minors.Many of these people struggle with problems related to addiction or mental illness, resulting from, among others,from a feeling of closure and isolation.

programs.title: Nightmare Next Door
programs.desc: A series of programs presenting authentic stories of people who disappeared in strange circumstances, and during the investigation it turned out that they were murdered by family members, friends or neighbors whom they had known for years.Murders committed by people close to the victim occur much more often than is commonly believed.Investigations in such cases are difficult and often lead to shocking conclusions.The program used police photos and recordings, and a number of interviews were held with the victims' families.
